EUREKA PROGRAM

Innovation Olympics

Eureka is delivered through Innovation Olympics using a real corporate challenge. It can be run with university student teams or with employees inside the company. In both cases, selected outputs can continue into IXLerator as a direct corporate project.

UNIVERSITY-BASED

Students + Corporate Challenge

University student teams work on a real company challenge through a course-based Innovation Olympics program.

Can continue to IXLerator as a corporate project after the university course
CORPORATE-BASED

Employees + Corporate Challenge

Company employees work on their own strategic challenge through a corporate Innovation Olympics engagement.

Can continue directly to IXLerator as a corporate project
INSIDE EUREKA

From Growth Intent to Business Concepts

Innovation Olympics structures the Eureka stage around five connected steps that turn a strategic challenge into actionable growth concepts and initial cases.

JUMP START

Assess Innovation Readiness

Start with two complementary assessments: OIA for the organization’s Innovation Management System and IPA for the innovation capability of its people. Each assessment identifies gaps and guides the next development and certification pathway.

OIA

Organizational Innovation Assessment

Assess the organization’s Innovation Management System, identify gaps against the target management-system level, and determine readiness for the ISO 56001 certification pathway.

View ISO 56001 Certification Process →
IPA

Innovation Potential Assessment

Assess individual innovation capability across the organization, identify gaps against target innovation roles, and determine the appropriate CIP development pathway.

View Profile →Download PDF ↓
View IPA / CIP Development Process →

OIA → ISO 56001 CERTIFICATION

ISO 56001 Certification Process

OIA evaluates the organization’s Innovation Management System and identifies the gap between the current state and the target certification level. If the target has already been achieved, certification can proceed. If gaps remain, IXL Korea supports Innovation Management Consulting before re-audit and certification.

01OIA / System AuditAssess current Innovation Management System
→
02Gap AnalysisCompare current state with target level
→
03IMS ConsultingClose gaps where required
→
04Re-AuditConfirm target achievement
→
05CertificationAward the applicable certificate

Innovation Management System Certification Levels

LEVEL 1GIMI Certificate
LEVEL 2GIMI Certificate
LEVEL 3GIMI–ISO 56001 Certificate
LEVEL 4GIMI–ISO+ Certificate

IPA → CIP CERTIFICATION

People Capability Development Process

IPA assesses the innovation capability of individuals across the organization and identifies the gap between current capability and the level required for innovation roles. The results guide targeted capability development and the appropriate CIP certification pathway, helping build the people required for a stronger innovation organization.

01IPA AssessmentAssess individual innovation capability
→
02Gap AnalysisCompare with target innovation roles
→
03Capability DevelopmentBuild missing knowledge and practice
→
04CIP CertificationAchieve the appropriate CIP level
→
05Innovation OrganizationDeploy stronger innovation talent

CIP Certification Levels

LEVEL 1CIP 1 Certificate
LEVEL 2CIP 2 Certificate
LEVEL 3CIP 3 Certificate
LEVEL 4CIP 4 Certificate

INSIGHTS

Explore What Is Shaping the Future of Innovation

News, articles, videos and selected external resources on innovation, growth, emerging trends, cases and new opportunities.

BEYOND EUREKA BOOK SERIES

HEALTHOVATE! INNOVATING TO LIVE LONGER, FEEL BETTER

Ronald Jonash, Pamela McNamara, Hitendra Patel

Healthovate! is a collection of stories of more than fifty innovative companies whose breakthroughs are changing the healthcare industry. These companies have created specific breakthroughs that are dramatically changing the way people receive and use products and services that enrich their health and well-being. Hult International Business School Publishing, Dec 2013

CONNECTIVATE! COMPANIES INNOVATING IN NEW WAYS TO BE ALWAYS AVAILABLE

Ronald Jonash, Victor Fernandes, Hitendra Patel, Steve Wyatt

Connectivate! is a collection of stories of more than fifty innovative companies whose breakthroughs are changing the world. These companies have created a new economic context, making themselves increasingly accessible to create a space-time singularity called Always Available. Hult International Business School Publishing, May 2012

GREENOVATE! COMPANIES INNOVATING TO CREATE A MORE SUSTAINABLE WORLD

Ronald Jonash, Tyler McNally, Hitendra Patel

Greenovate! is a compilation of stories of how many of the world’s leading and emerging companies are addressing sustainability issues with profitable solutions that can spur even more innovation, growth and development as individuals and companies realize that being green DOES NOT MEAN being in the red. Hult International Business School Publishing, Apr 2012

GAME CHANGERS. 232 INNOVATIONS THAT HAVE SHAPED OUR WORLD

Hitendra Patel, Mark Rennella, Julija Kaminskaite

Game Changers gives readers a horizontal and vertical view of the wide reach of innovation over time and its impact on the lives of individuals and societies. Innovation has shaped human history in decisive ways. From light bulbs to lasers, from plumbing to water purification, innovation has helped human beings deal with change, cope with major problems and to achieve what had once seemed either impossible or even unthinkable. Global Innovation Management Institute Publishing, October 2017

OTHER INNOVATION BOOKS

THE STATE OF INNOVATION AT FIRM LEVEL IN SINGAPORE

Hitendra Patel, Eduardo Chakarian

Monitor Group, together with Singapore’s Institute of Policy Studies, led a study to assess the state of innovation capabilities in Singapore both at firm and national levels. This flagship study also compares Singapore’s innovation capabilities with those in other leading economies, and has developed a revealing set of insights on the policies, actions and initiatives needed to strengthen innovation capabilities and performance in Singapore. Institute of Policy Studies; 1st edition, 2005

THE INNOVATION PREMIUM: HOW NEXT GENERATION COMPANIES ARE ACHIEVING PEAK PERFORMANCE AND PROFITABILITY

Ronald Jonash, Tom Sommerlatte (at Arthur D. Little)

In today’s constantly shifting marketplace, “innovation” has become the catchword of companies large and small. In The Innovation Premium, Ron Jonash and Tom Sommerlatte draw on years of research and experience to demonstrate-for the first time-that those companies that consistently achieve innovation leadership enjoy measurable advantages, including an average 15 percent increase in shareholder returns.

ENTREPRENEURS, MANAGERS, AND LEADERS: WHAT THE AIRLINE INDUSTRY CAN TEACH US ABOUT LEADERSHIP

Anthony Mayo, Nitin Nohria, Mark Rennella

Entrepreneurs, Managers, and Leaders examines the role that business leaders play in shaping industries and how the evolving context of industries shapes leaders in turn. This co-evolutionary process of leadership and industry development is told through the story of the American airline industry across the 20th century. Entrepreneurs, who explored a variety of different airline concepts in search of a viable business model, dominate the industry’s early history.

Technovate!: A Guide to the Technologies Revolutionizing our World

Hitendra Patel, PH.D

Technovate! is your essential guide to navigating the rapidly evolving landscape of technology and innovation. Whether you're a business student, manager, engineer, or simply a curious mind, this book provides actionable insights and shareable understanding to help you thrive in the age of technovation. Explore the future of business, technology, and society, while understanding the importance of ethical decision making. Discover how to leverage emerging technologies to drive growth, solve complex problems, and shape a brighter future.

Our Products

Technovate!

Technovate! provides a detailed exploration of these cutting-edge technologies, organized into distinct chapters that delve into key areas of innovation. We begin with Digital Technologies and Advanced Computing: The Backbone of the Future, examining the impact of AI, machine learning, quantum computing, and other digital advancements. We then move into Biotechnology and Healthcare: The Convergence of Biology and Technology, exploring breakthroughs in gene editing, personalized medicine, and bioengineering.

Join us on this journey of exploration and discovery as we delve into the world of Technovate! and unlock the potential of technology to create a future that is both innovative and equitable, prosperous and sustainable, for all.

ARTICLE · MAY 2024

Identifying and Developing Innovation Talent

How organizations can evaluate innovation potential, understand different innovation profiles and place people where they can contribute most effectively to innovation.

01

Why Innovation Talent Matters

Innovation depends on more than technical expertise. Organizations need to understand the behaviors, mindset and practical innovation capabilities of their people in order to identify who can lead, join or prepare for innovation work.

02

Mindset + Knowledge & Tools

The Innovation Potential Assessment evaluates two dimensions: Innovation Mindset and Knowledge & Tools. Together they provide a quantitative view of an individual's readiness to contribute to innovation outcomes.

03

Seven Innovation Profiles

The combination of mindset and innovation know-how maps individuals into seven profiles — from Rule Follower and Rule Executor to Diamond in the Rough, Optimistic Executor, Rule Challenger, Rule Breaker and Rule Maker.

04

Put the Aces in the Right Places

Assessment results can help organizations identify who is ready to lead innovation projects, who can join innovation teams and who would benefit most from additional training.

05

Build Customized Development Journeys

Individual and aggregate results can be translated into tailored development paths by profile, role and seniority — helping organizations build capability while improving innovation results.

Source GIM Institute · Innovation Potential Assessment · May 2024
